name: JSON Wrapper
author: NPad++ Community
summary: Embed JSON in source code as a string literal, styled for the document's language (Java, Python, C, C++, C#, JS/TS, Go, Rust, Swift, Kotlin, PHP, Ruby, Shell).
documentation: Select JSON (or leave nothing selected for the whole document) and run "Wrap JSON for Current Language": the plugin picks the right literal style from the document language - Java text block, Python triple-quoted string, adjacent C string literals, C++ raw string, C# verbatim string, JS template literal, Go/Rust/Swift raw strings, Kotlin raw string, PHP nowdoc, Ruby heredoc or a single-quoted shell string. Use the "Wrap as..." commands to choose a language explicitly (handy in a .json file). The text must be valid JSON; "Minified" compacts it first.

commands.title: Wrap Minified JSON for Current Language
